youtube.description:
Dadi ne poocha: "Mera BP high rehta hai, kya operation ruk jaayega?" 😟
Dr Saathi ne kaha: har baar nahi Dadi! Bahut zyada ho tabhi, pehle BP control karte hain. 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Hospital mein ghabrahat ya tension se bhi BP thoda badh jaata hai
✅ BP 180/110 se upar ho toh planned operation kuch samay ke liye tal sakta hai, taaki pehle BP control ho
✅ Operation ke dauraan anaesthesia doctor kam se kam har 5 minute mein BP check karte hain
✅ BP ki dawa kab leni hai, yeh apne doctor ki batayi timing se hi kijiye
Koi bhi sawaal ho, apne doctor se poochhiye.

Darr nahi, taiyaari!
